name: Street Fighter-tachi no Yoru
original_name: ストリートファイターたちの夜
source:
A night of tragedy unfolds after a group of fighters find a mysterious note. On it reads the words "Tonight@midnight=d..."

[From scenario selection menu]

A collaboration Sound Novel between Street Fighter 6 and [url=/v1241]Kamaitachi no Yoru[/url], featured as a free-update campaign for Street Fighter 6.
translation:
一群战士发现一张神秘的纸条后，悲剧之夜展开。上面写着“今晚@午夜=d……”

[从场景选择菜单]

《街头霸王6》和 [url=/v1241]Kamaitachi no Yoru[/url] 合作的声音小说，作为《街头霸王6》的免费更新活动。
